title: Token-2022 metadata pointer
detects: An authority that can repoint the mint at a different metadata account, changing the name, symbol and image every wallet and explorer shows for this token.
knownFalseNegative: A metadataAddress equal to the mint itself is the ordinary arrangement alongside the tokenMetadata extension and is not evidence of reduced mutability: the content at that address is still governed by tokenMetadata.updateAuthority, which is read separately. This pattern reads only who can move the pointer.

coversExamples.observed: PRESENT, authority 2apBGMsS6ti9RyF5TwQTDswXBWskiJP2LD4cUEDqYJjk, pointing at the mint itself

rationale: A token's public identity is what a holder recognises it by. An address that can rewrite it after people have looked is a transparency capability, and nothing else in the dictionary reads it on Token-2022.
